title: Deterministic proof of possession
acceptance: PoP is an Ed25519 signature over the JCS value with typ amk-ata-issuance-pop-v1, aud, session_public_key, session_handle, epoch, role, request_nonce and request_timestamp
Wrong key, tampered field, wrong audience and replayed request nonce are all rejected
findings: Correction: imported message omitted typ and aud (cross-Authority replay) and included declared_roles.
